adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the new call `refreshOAuthTokens(..., "zoho-bigin", credentialId)` passes a variable named `credentialId` as the third argument, while the helper’s signature is `(…, appSlug, userId)` and in sync mode it sends that value as `calcomUserId` (`refreshOAuthTokens.ts`: `calcomUserId: userId.toString()`). All other updated call sites pass `credential.userId`, so this is a concrete, diff-visible inconsistency that would cause the sync endpoint to receive the wrong identifier if `credentialId` is indeed the credential’s DB id (as its name strongly implies).
